description: Gravitas v4 enforcement hooks for Antigravity 2.0

hooks.description: Enforces action lock, write scope, read-before-write, and duplicate failure prevention before any tool call executes.
Records tool execution to evidence ledger. Logs failures with retry fingerprint. Tracks affected files.
Persists session state to .gravitas/sessions/ after each invocation for interruption recovery.
Completion gate. Verifies all acceptance criteria have evidence before allowing the agent to stop.
